title: 雨上がりの金木犀と、母の煮物
author: 久我山 灯子

en.title: Osmanthus After the Rain and Mother's Stew
en.premise: When her father's death prompts her to return to her hometown after ten years, Sayo discovers her mother has shut herself off and the nostalgic scent lingering in the old family shop. Through her father's beloved "Dawn Radio" and the heirloom stew that has been passed down through generations, the fragmented family begins to reclaim the time they lost.

zh.title: 雨后金木犀与母亲的炖菜
zh.premise: 父亲的去世让早耶十年后回到故乡。她发现母亲闭口不言，古老的店里弥漫着熟悉的气味。通过父亲钟爱的「夜明けのラジオ」以及代代相传的炖菜味道，支离破碎的家庭逐渐找回失去的时光。
